summary.zh: update 输出措辞与备份位置：--client 选定的客户端不再被称为“其他客户端”；预览被阻塞时不再提示追加 --apply；update 的预览写明被替换文件的备份位置、apply 写出实际路径（内容步骤与 Cursor 都覆盖），--recovery-dir 对 Cursor 步骤同样生效；config 的写子命令（含 project-language）支持 --recovery-dir（#80）。
summary.en: update wording and backup location: a client chosen with --client is no longer called an "other client"; a blocked preview no longer tells you to add --apply; update previews name where replaced files will be backed up and --apply prints the actual path (content step and Cursor); --recovery-dir now also applies to Cursor steps; the config write sub-commands (including project-language) accept --recovery-dir (#80).
